requiredBehaviors.behavior: complete one track before beginning the next track
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Phase 4 Mobile Copy/Paste Contract explicitly requires completing one track before starting the next.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: give Title Lyrics and Style their own dedicated copyable blocks
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The Mobile Copy/Paste Contract states that one real Suno input field receives one dedicated copyable block, while the standard handoff order is Title, Lyrics, Style.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: keep field labels and explanations outside the copyable blocks
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Phase 4 explicitly requires the field label to remain outside the copyable block.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: put only exact paste-ready field content inside each copyable block
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The contract states that each block contains only the exact text to paste into Suno.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: put BPM key target length and vocals or melody guidance inside Style when there is no separate Suno field
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Phase 4 Style requirements place BPM/meter, key/mode, target length and Vocals / Melody inside the Style block.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: omit unused placeholder fields and catch-all miscellaneous sections
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The workflow forbids a Sonstiges/Misc catch-all when content belongs in Style or Advanced controls and explicitly disallows empty placeholder blocks for unused Suno fields.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: optimize the handoff for minimal searching and switching on mobile
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The dedicated per-field block rule, one-track-at-a-time order, external labels and no-subsection-selection requirement jointly minimize mobile searching, text selection and app switching.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: put Title Lyrics or Style labels inside the text the user is meant to paste
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Phase 4 requires labels outside the copyable blocks.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: mix commentary metadata and paste-ready content in one large block
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The one-real-field-one-block rule and exact-paste-text-only rule prevent commentary or metadata from being mixed into the paste payload.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: group all album titles first then all lyrics then all styles
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The workflow explicitly says to complete one track before starting the next, preserving Title -> Lyrics -> Style per track.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: force the user to manually select a subsection from a larger block
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The Mobile Copy/Paste Contract explicitly says not to make the user manually select a subsection from a larger block.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: create empty blocks for unused Suno fields
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Phase 4 explicitly forbids empty placeholder blocks for Suno fields that are not used.
